Why Your AI App Breaks After You Add a Custom Domain

When your app breaks after adding a custom domain, the code is fine. Something got pinned to the old preview address and didn't move with you. Check five things: the frontend's API URL (change it and rebuild), the API's CORS allow-list, your cookie domain and SameSite, your OAuth and webhook URLs at each provider, and whether HTTPS is fully forced.
